thread:
maria_customer: Hey @jess_support — we rotated keys yesterday and since then our service is getting 401 invalid_api_key on every request. Can someone help?

maria_customer: Posting the curl we use (redacted slightly):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat 
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer https://dashboard.redwood.ai/key/AK-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h\" 
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" 
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

jess_support: Thanks — quick question: did you copy the key from the dashboard copy button or paste it from an email/notes?

maria_customer: I used the dashboard copy button. It looked fine when I pasted.

sam_repro: Quick sanity check: the Authorization header should contain only the raw key token (or Bearer <raw-key>), not a full dashboard URL. Can you try this exact header and re-run?

sam_repro: Example (replace the key with yours):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat 
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer AK-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h\" 
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" 
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

jess_support: We occasionally see the dashboard \"copy\" control returning a management URL (https://dashboard.redwood.ai/key/...) for some browser/extension combos. That URL will not be accepted by the API and results in 401. If you paste the raw token it should work.

maria_customer: Trying now...

maria_customer: That fixed it, thanks! Requests succeed with 200 after removing the dashboard URL prefix.

jess_support: Great — thanks for confirming. We'll follow up with engineering to check the dashboard copy behaviour. For now:
- If you have CI or services that use the key, make sure they store only the raw token (no URL).
- Rotate the dashboard key again if you'd like — the old URL won't work and you can replace it with the raw token.

sam_repro: Filing a quick internal note: devops-bot, please capture a short repro and tag eng-ml/console if copy-button returns the full URL in any browsers/extensions.

devops-bot: Created ticket INF-8421 with repro steps and the example headers.

maria_customer: Appreciate the help! :thumbsup:

jess_support: Closing the thread for now — reopen if anything else pops up.
summary: customer copied dashboard URL instead of raw API key causing 401; support verified and provided correct header; engineering ticket created
